method: Organiser data was read from the organisers' own match-centre feeds that power their match pages: match.uefa.com/v5 (UEFA), api.fifa.com/api/v3 (FIFA), footballapi.pulselive.com (premierleague.com) and the copaamerica.com match page (CONMEBOL). The FA publishes no line-up for the 2025 FA Cup final; its report was read for score and venue only.

Independent data was read from ESPN's summary feed (the data behind espn.com line-up pages), Sky Sports team sheets and BeSoccer match pages. worldfootball.net (HTTP 402/403), bbc.co.uk and theguardian.com could not be fetched from this machine.

Sky Sports venue lines for neutral-ground finals are unreliable (2001 final says Athens, 2006 says Nou Camp, 2007 says San Siro) and ESPN has one venue error (2002 final says BayArena); venues were therefore settled on the organiser plus a second host, with the outlier recorded.

Formation rule: same when the sources that state a shape support the entry's label or an equivalent notation of the same placement; when the organiser and the independent split, a third source (BeSoccer, page read directly) breaks the tie and the result is flagged. A formation no source states is listed under unconfirmedFields, not as a diff. Search-engine summaries of BeSoccer pages were wrong three times (2010 Bayern, FA Cup 2025, one Euro 2012 listing), so only direct page reads are cited.
Every one of the 32 elevens matches its sources name for name; all seven differs verdicts are formation labels only. Dates, scores, venues and competition stages match in every lineup.
Not checked: blankCandidates facts, nationalities, clubAtTime, and the in-code comments, which are outside this brief.
